Name: Hidden River Farm
Author: ariasonata
Description:
This is a new riverland farm. It's built for someone who does not want a massive map but wants something pretty, simple, and natural. 
There is a hot springs, and plenty of room for a few farm buildings and crops, I do hope you enjoy it!

This map replaces the Riverland Farm Map, so please understand it will not load on any other map without changing the cp in notepad+ or whatever.

Downloads.Description: Added MP housing functionality (hopefully), no other changes
